name: Avatar Scenario
tagline: Build an interactive assistant or a repeatable content-production application.
customer_outcome: Users get grounded help, or content owners run a repeatable media workflow, with accessible output and controlled release in their tenant.
decision_prompts: Are we building an interactive assistant or a repeatable content-production application, and what proves that application works?
Which communication, learning, or support moment should the pilot serve first, and for which audience, locale, and channel?
Which media format serves that application goal, and does an avatar add value over audio or text?
Which approved sources and named owners may support the script, and when do they expire?
Who must approve factual accuracy, legal/compliance, brand, and accessibility before anything is published?
How will the experience disclose synthetic/AI assistance and offer human help without deceptive representation?
Which evaluation, red-team, and operational measures decide whether to iterate, scale, pause, or withdraw?

lessons.title: Choose the application your users need
Add grounded authoring or live answers when needed

build_modules.title: Choose the application your users need
build_modules.summary: Choose interactive assistance or repeatable content production before selecting a media format. Agree application acceptance checks and prove feasibility.
build_modules.outcome: An agreed application goal, with a user task or workflow trigger and delivery owners

build_modules.title: Connect the required foundation
build_modules.summary: Reuse approved tenant resources and verify runtime access. Add models or indexed retrieval only when the chosen experience needs them.
build_modules.outcome: Foundry and Speech resources with a usable environment contract

build_modules.title: Connect content and approve wording
build_modules.summary: Connect authoritative content and keep its version and expiry. For content production, detect source changes and approve replacement wording before rendering.
build_modules.outcome: Approved wording bound to authoritative source revisions

build_modules.title: Add grounded authoring or live answers when needed
build_modules.summary: Skip generation when wording is already approved. Otherwise connect the approved sources and prove citations, refusal, and support routing.
build_modules.outcome: Approved-claim answers with citations and a refusal path

build_modules.title: Connect generation to the application
build_modules.summary: Connect generation jobs to the content workflow or live rendering to the assistant client. Include accessible alternatives and recover failed jobs without duplicate output.
build_modules.outcome: A working generation path in the application, with accessible output

build_modules.title: Approve publication and prove withdrawal
build_modules.summary: Use the customer's approval system to authorize the exact media revision. Prove publication and withdrawal in the actual user channel.
build_modules.outcome: Authorized publication and tested withdrawal from the serving channel

build_modules.title: Evaluate, red-team, trace, and operate
build_modules.summary: Prove the assistant through its authenticated client or a complete source-update cycle through the deployed content workflow. Test failure recovery and withdrawal before release.
build_modules.outcome: Application acceptance evidence with an operating owner; a generated video alone is insufficient
